title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo Leads LPGA
items.text: Soo Bin Joo shot a 3-under 68 in strong winds at the ShopRite LPGA and stretched her lead to four shots at 8-under 134 with just one bogey so far.

items.headline: Former LIV Leader Reflects
items.text: Eugenio Chacarra left LIV Golf due to lack of major opportunities and aims to improve his mental game and wedge play to become the best player worldwide.
